Title: Collector server upload endpoint
Description: As a desktop user, I want to upload extracted knowledge to the collector server so it lands in Cortexa without my original files leaving the machine.
AcceptanceCriteria: POST /collector/batches/knowledge on the collector server accepts {batch_name, collector{app_version,provider,model,prompt_version}, documents[{client_document_id, filename, source_kind, source_type, knowledge_items[]}]} and returns {batch_id, document_ids[]}
JWT check re-implemented from the gateway (HS256 signature, issuer, audience, expiry) plus the identity stamp check (fail closed); token must carry org_id and perms must include jobs:submit

Validation: source_kind (paper, code) and source_type (local, github, azure_devops, ssh, cortexa_repo) as separate fields; kinds, unit_kind x source_kind rules, excerpt <=400 chars, size caps from config; documents with zero items are dropped
Filename is sanitized on the server (control and bidi characters removed)
Idempotency-Key header is required; batch_id = UUIDv5(user id + key); an existing saga returns the original result
Engine must be harvesting, seeding or dual; saga carries org_id, owner_user_id, batch_name, created_at and model fields from the config row
Calls the US122 writers and publishers; never logs excerpts, knowledge text or tokens
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: The desktop uploads straight to the collector server. Sign-in stays on the gateway; the server validates the same JWT with re-implemented logic.
